title: coryphantha chlorantha
intro: Coryphantha chlorantha, commonly known as the green pitaya cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is known for its vibrant green stems and small white flowers. The health benefits of Coryphantha chlorantha include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
